compute_surrogate_reward: compute the surrogate reward from a raw reward and steps to go with thresholding and step penalty
surrogate_reward_to_value_fn_target: map a surrogate reward value to a value function target by scaling and rounding
value_fn_output_to_surrogate_reward: convert a value function output back to a surrogate reward by dividing by the scalar
test_compute_surrogate_reward: test compute_surrogate_reward with raw reward 1.0 and steps_to_go 10 to verify thresholding and penalty
refactor_surrogate_reward_to_value_fn_ta: refactor surrogate_reward_to_value_fn_target to support configurable scalar instead of hardcoded VALUE_FN_SCALAR
